headline_marked: [[Chhatra Dal attack]] at RU injures 10, including 4 journalists
headline: Chhatra Dal attack at RU injures 10, including 4 journalists
summary: Journalists covering a protest rally at Rajshahi University were assaulted by Chhatra Dal activists when they attempted to film demonstrators openly carrying weapons. At least 10 people, including four journalists, sustained injuries in the incident.
details: Journalists performing their duties at Rajshahi University were attacked by Chhatra Dal activists on Sunday night. The incident occurred near the Shahid Ziaur Rahman Hall when reporters tried to video record a protest rally where participants were seen openly carrying traditional weapons, including ramdas.

Eyewitnesses reported that the protest march, organized by the university's Chhatra Dal unit, began from the transport market area and proceeded through various roads before reaching the hall. Several activists were observed carrying sharp weapons during the procession.

When journalists present at the scene attempted to capture the display of weapons on video, the protesters became agitated. They obstructed the journalists and subsequently physically assaulted and harassed them.

The dispute reportedly stemmed from an online argument. A Facebook post by a Chhatra Dal leader, M Ahsan Habib, regarding the university's Central Student Union (Raksu) GS Salahuddin Amma, had created tension on campus, leading to the armed protest.

Rajshahi University Chhatra Dal President Sultan Ahmed Rahi stated that the organization is investigating the incident. He assured that strict disciplinary action would be taken against any member found involved in misconduct or attacking journalists.

headline_marked: Singer Pritam Hasan and [[model Shehtaz Monira have decided to divorce]]
headline: Singer Pritam Hasan and model Shehtaz Monira have decided to divorce
summary: The couple, who were together for a decade, cited major differences in mutual understanding as the reason for their separation.
details: Singer and actor Pritam Hasan and model-actress and singer Shehtaz Monira Hashem have announced their decision to end their marriage.
Both shared the news via separate Facebook posts on Sunday night, stating that they have decided to go their separate ways due to major differences in mutual understanding.
Pritam wrote that after a ten-year journey together, they have decided to end their marital relationship, while expressing gratitude for the time, memories, and experiences they shared.
The decision was not sudden, but was reached after careful thought, mutual discussion, and with the support and consent of their families.
Shehtaz also confirmed the separation in her own post, emphasizing that the split is amicable and based on mutual respect and well-wishes for each other.
The couple first met in 2017 while working on the music video for Pritam's popular song 'Jadukor', where Shehtaz was the model.
After a long relationship, they married on October 29, 2022, at a hotel in Sreemangal, in the presence of and family members and close friends.
Both have requested privacy and empathy from friends, colleagues, and the media during this transition in their lives.
caption:
After a decade-long journey, Pritam Hasan and Shehtaz Monira are parting ways.

Singer and actor Pritam Hasan and model-actress and singer Shehtaz Monira Hashem have announced their decision to end their marriage.

Both shared the news via separate Facebook posts on Sunday night, stating that they have decided to go their separate ways due to major differences in mutual understanding.

Pritam wrote that after a ten-year journey together, they have decided to end their marital relationship, while expressing gratitude for the time, memories, and experiences they shared.

The decision was not sudden, but was reached after careful thought, mutual discussion, and with the support and consent of their families.

Shehtaz also confirmed the separation in her own post, emphasizing that the split is amicable and based on mutual respect and well-wishes for each other.

The couple first met in 2017 while working on the music video for Pritam's popular song 'Jadukor', where Shehtaz was the model.

After a long relationship, they married on October 29, 2022, at a hotel in Sreemangal, in the presence of and family members and close friends.

Both have requested privacy and empathy from friends, colleagues, and the media during this transition in their lives.
